item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril rgyud las sbyin bsregs cha lag las bzhi kun tshang
item.coloph: zhes bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi sbyin sreg las bzhi kun tshang 'di yang grub gnyis khyung mchog spa ston g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bka' yis 'di ltar sgrab pa chen po'i 'kho (rkyen rnams) gyis shig pa'i gsung pheb pa la brten/ kho bo o rgyan rat+na gling pas g.yung drung rab brtan gling du spel ba/ yi ge pa ni nye gnas 'gru bon tshul khrims dbang grags gi (kyis) bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/
